name: Convention Crush
source:
Embark on a heartwarming journey in "Convention Crush", a cozy and heartfelt romance/dating sim visual novel. 

Attend a bustling convention alone, eager to immerse yourself in the world of your favorite game. Amidst the vibrant crowd, you chance upon another attendee cosplaying from the same universe. Drawn together by your shared fandom, you spend the day exploring the convention, engaging in activities, and forging a special connection. As the event draws to a close, a surprising revelation unfolds: your newfound friend isn't what you thought. 

[From [url=https://xenubinstudios.itch.io/convention-crush]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在《Convention Crush》中踏上一段温馨的旅程，这是一部舒适而真挚的浪漫/约会模拟视觉小说。

独自参加热闹的会议，渴望沉浸在你最喜欢的游戏世界中。在充满活力的人群中，你偶然会遇到来自同一个宇宙的另一位角色扮演者。你们被共同的粉丝群体吸引在一起，花一天时间探索大会、参与活动并建立特殊的联系。随着活动接近尾声，一个令人惊讶的发现逐渐浮出水面：你的新朋友并不是你想象的那样。

[来自[url=https://xenubinstudios.itch.io/convention-crush]itch.io[/url]]
